title: Testing and debugging
summary: Write small tests, reproduce failures, and fix the root cause.

scenario.briefing: The sumEven function returns undefined for an empty list and adds odd numbers instead of even ones. Fix it and add tests that cover the empty case.

objectives.description: Fix sumEven to sum only even numbers.
Transfer debugging habits to new code.

hints: Handle an empty array by returning 0.
let total = 0; for (const n of numbers) { if (n % 2 === 0) total += n; } return total;

misconceptions.feedback: An accumulator must start at 0. An undefined accumulator returns undefined for empty input and NaN once a value is added.

misconceptions.description: Summing odd numbers instead of even.
Believing console.log is a sufficient test.
misconceptions.feedback: Console output is not a repeatable test. Write assertions that fail on regressions.

sections.title: Reproduce first
sections.body: A bug fix starts with a failing test that reproduces the problem. Without reproduction, you cannot know the fix worked.

sections.title: Small, focused tests
sections.body: Test boundaries such as empty input, one item, and mixed input. Assertions should be specific about expected values.

sections.title: Root cause
sections.body: Fix the shared logic once instead of patching each call site. Re-run all tests after the change.
